description:
Make the `scripts/benchmark-session-cost-selftest.sh` self-test pass as the registered gate `session-cost-benchmark-selftest` over the script it tests.

## Background

`scripts/benchmark-session-cost-selftest.sh` is a re-runnable self-test of `scripts/benchmark-session-cost.sh`, run against a fake `jit` and checked against the benchmark's output contract. It exits 2 when `cmp`, `find`, `git`, `grep`, `jq` or `sha256sum` is missing. Until planning, no gate ran it. The gate `session-cost-benchmark-selftest` was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning, so this task and the container can require it; this task makes it pass and keeps its inputs complete.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `session-cost-benchmark-selftest` runs `scripts/benchmark-session-cost-selftest.sh`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `session-cost-benchmark-selftest` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
title: Session-cost benchmark self-test runs as a declared gate
